page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred; a woodcut device in the middle with a line of print below it; handwritten ownership inscription at right (not transcribed as print).

main_text.l: Accesserunt Indices duo, Rerum et Verborum unus: alter
sacræ Scripturæ Locorum, qui hoc libro explicantur.
Ecce agnus ille Dei, qui tollit peccatum Mundi.

page.notes: The woodcut device (a wolf among sheep, with putti and the legend "CHRISTVS PACIFICATOR NOSTER") is not transcribed as text. The handwritten inscription "Joannis Jacobi Ochsneri Sam..." with "1620" is manuscript and omitted. The year line reads "XCVI" in the printed form; the scan's last letters are slightly worn, so the final numeral is a reading with [?] in doubt: M. D. XCVI[?].
